stories.title: Erie County residents will pay more for water starting in 2027
stories.summary: The Erie County Water Authority says a new rate increase will help fund nearly $79 million in infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Buffalo schools face hard control warning after closure plan fails
stories.summary: The Buffalo Fiscal Stability Authority warns that Buffalo Public Schools is inching closer to hard control status after the closure plan was rejected on Wednesday.

stories.title: Lockport installs 4-way stop after two fatal crashes in 11 days
stories.summary: A new four-way stop is coming to a Town of Lockport intersection after two deadly crashes there within 11 days.

stories.title: Anchor Bar says 'disaster was averted' after multiple gas leaks
stories.summary: The restaurant says it's ready to welcome customers back and resume game-day traditions this weekend.

stories.title: The BFLO Store opens new Western New York location in Southtowns
stories.summary: The new 13,000-square-foot location features a sports lounge, exclusive merchandise, and a grand opening celebration.

stories.title: Appeals court overturns $100M verdict in Richard Metcalf Jr. death
stories.summary: A New York appeals court has overturned a $100 million verdict awarded to the family of Richard Metcalf Jr., finding problems with how jurors were instructed.

stories.title: New UB North Campus structure to house AI supercomputer system for research uses
stories.summary: State officials say this computer system will open up even more research opportunities as it utilizes artificial intelligence.

stories.title: FeedMore WNY Opens $115M Hamburg headquarters, expanding capacity to fight hunger
stories.summary: Officials say the new warehouse has the space to hold 5 million pounds of food, which is 2 million pounds more than its Buffalo location.

stories.title: 'Turning pain into purpose': Buffalo mothers lead effort to create 1,000-face memorial quilt
stories.summary: Organizers working to create a quilt with 1,000 faces of Western New Yorkers who had untimely deaths.

stories.title: Buffalo woman accused of possessing large quantities of fentanyl, cocaine
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors say a 48-year-old woman faces charges after an investigation into fentanyl and cocaine.

stories.title: Buffalo Elementary School of Technology student falls from second-story window
stories.summary: BPS says an elementary student fell from a second story window on Wednesday. The teacher and teacher aide have both been placed on paid administrative leave.

stories.title: Amherst clears hurdle in Boulevard Mall Redevelopment Plan
stories.summary: State Supreme Court Justice Raymond Walter has authorized Amherst to acquire vacant parts of the Boulevard Mall site through eminent domain.
